name: markdown-magic
description: A local macOS Markdown workspace with WYSIWYG editing and grouped tabs.
author: MediaPublishing

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron && playwright test
scripts.quality: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.screenshots:marketing: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron && playwright test tests/marketing-screenshots.spec.ts
scripts.deploy:pages: wrangler pages deploy site --project-name markdown-magic --branch main
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dmg
scripts.package:mac:app: npm run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dir
